data.name: Incrawler
data.detailed_description:
Incrawler is an incremental dungeon-crawling experience where you slay enemies, collect valuable loot, and grow your party to venture ever deeper into darkness. Face increasingly powerful foes as you push further and test the limits of your strategy.

Choose your heroes’ skill paths wisely to create powerful synergies and unlock their true potential. Every decision matters—careful planning will determine whether your party thrives or falls.

Earn gold from defeated monsters to upgrade abilities and unlock new options in expansive skill trees.

Gather and invest Mastery Points to shape each character’s unique traits and playstyle. Every conquered dungeon rewards you with additional masteries, encouraging experimentation and new tactical approaches.

Each dungeon has unique bosses for you to try and outwit.

When you feel overwhelmed, Prestige to gain permanent unlocks and powerful bonuses for your party. These long-term upgrades will accelerate your progress and open the path to even greater challenges.

Grind for gold, refine your builds, discover the strongest synergies, and conquer deadly dungeons on your journey to defeat the final boss.
